contradiction_1_baseline_recall.root_cause: The value 61.35% was an accidental transcription error in the Gate 4.1 response summary text. The underlying JSON artifact (phase3a_gate4_independent_metrics.json), the audit report, and the audited markdown report correctly computed 53.87% across all 9 projects.
contradiction_1_baseline_recall.resolution: Corrected in all canonical tables and prose to 53.87% (9-project macro) and 60.60% (8-project defined macro).

contradiction_2_quantile_recall.root_cause: 42.66% was derived in the summary prose by subtracting an erroneous -18.69% delta from the erroneous 61.35% baseline. The true raw recomputed recall is 42.7517% (macro across 9 projects), representing an exact -11.12 percentage point absolute drop from the 53.87% baseline (-20.64% relative).
contradiction_2_quantile_recall.resolution: Authoritatively fixed to 42.75% macro recall, -11.12 percentage points absolute difference, and -20.64% relative change.

contradiction_3_httpclient_recall.root_cause: The value 55.98% was copied directly from the Phase 3A Gate 3 Pilot report (where tau=0.373 produced precision=55.48% and recall=55.98%). In the Gate 4 full benchmark on 3,190 post-burn-in commits, the adapted threshold was tau=0.469, yielding precision=61.48% and recall=42.79%. The narrative recommendation had not been updated from the pilot text.
contradiction_3_httpclient_recall.resolution: Corrected narrative in all reports to state that precision reached 61.48% with 42.79% recall.
